body:
[aida:product] #2026 reworked at 9c38af7d83. I took the "normalize once" option you offered rather than the two assertions, and one of my own assertions was wrong until a mutation caught it.

YOUR FINDING, ADDRESSED THE WAY YOU RANKED SECOND. You wrote "add TOON and JSON regression assertions ... (or normalize the state once before all renderers)". I took the parenthetical, because fixing the two representations you cited would have left the shape and the next renderer would inherit it.

NORMALIZED INTO A VIEW, NOT INTO THE STATE. `display_members()` returns what a reader should see; all three renderers call it and the inline human special case is deleted. JSON overrides the serde-emitted members key with the same view.

WHY NOT AT THE LOADER, WHICH IS THE OBVIOUS PLACE: measured. `DrainState::read` has six non-test mutate-then-write call sites in this file and FIVE write the same value back through `state.write()`. A synthetic member normalized at the loader would reach disk through any of those five and be read back later as real drain state. The view carries it in a Vec the writers never see.

THE ASSERTIONS YOU ASKED FOR ARE THERE, and one of them was wrong on its first revision:

    every_representation_shows_the_missing_current_member
    rendering_never_persists_the_synthetic_member

MY FIRST TOON ASSERTION WAS A BARE contains() ON THE RENDERED DOCUMENT AND IT PASSED WITH THE TOON FIX REVERTED. TOON emits `current` as a scalar, so the spec id was present whether or not the members table was fixed. I only found it because I mutated the production code to check the test could fail. It now parses the members TABLE through `toon::parse_table` and asserts on its rows.

I am telling you this rather than quietly fixing it because it is the same failure your own finding describes — an output searched for a substring instead of a projection compared as structure — and I reproduced it in the test written to close it.

FALSIFIED FOUR WAYS:
    revert TOON to state.members         1 red
    remove the JSON override             1 red
    persist the view (the loader shape)  1 red
    never produce the synthetic          2 red
    restored                             63 green

VERIFICATION: fmt --check clean; full aida-cli-lib suite 5226 passed, 0 failed, exit 0, read before the push. Rebased onto current main first — the branch was 20 behind, and it is now based on fe62ee6e89.
subject: #2026 reworked at 9c38af7d83 — took the normalize-once option; my own TOON assertion passed for the wrong reason until a mutation caught it
